svg.title: How long can birds fly without landing?
svg.desc: Cleveland dot plot on a logarithmic time scale showing maximum nonstop flight durations for seven bird species and a commercial airliner shown for reference. Chicken is at 10 seconds, common swift at about 10 months. The data spans six orders of magnitude.
svg.text: How long can birds fly without landing?
Maximum nonstop flight, log time scale. Each step right represents 10x longer aloft.

g.text: Pigeon and steppe eagle are nearly tied at the four-day mark; their dots overlap on the axis.
The common swift sleeps and feeds on the wing, landing only to nest. The chicken is shown for scale.
Airplane (commercial airliner) is bounded by fuel and regulation, not biology — included for reference only.
Values from published ornithology estimates; precision varies. Original infographic encoded magnitude in color, not length.
